The sole failing check is C3 (linked to PF1, owner A2), which failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 3 but passed in rollout 2. Comparing the installation_scope field across rollouts reveals an ENCODING MISMATCH: rollout 2 (the only pass) wrote "One monitor installed in each of the nine separate classrooms in the science wing, each with its own ventilation zone," while the three failing rollouts wrote variations like "All nine separate science-wing classrooms with separate ventilation zones" or "Nine separate science-wing classrooms, each with its own ventilation zone." The check C3 apparently requires explicit per-classroom installation language ("one monitor installed in each"), but the model naturally encodes the scope as a list of rooms rather than a per-room installation statement, causing the check to fail even though the underlying fact was both revealed and cited.
